about.title: Making your numbers meaningful, without all the confusing jargon.
text: Thanks for checking out Kingsolver Bookkeeping! My mission is to help small businesses thrive by making their numbers meaningful without all the confusing jargon. With over 20 years of experience in accounting, I've built a solid foundation of knowledge and professionalism, always putting my clients' needs first.

I know that no two organizations are alike, which is why I take the time to understand what truly matters to you — whether it's your goals, your challenges, or what financial clarity means for your company. Every company is unique, and I make it my priority to support yours in the best way possible.

I graduated from Millsaps College and earned my Master's from the University of Houston. My career has revolved around accounting in many different industries — ranging from hospitality and oil & gas to directing a dental non-profit and consulting. No matter the field, I'm passionate about simplifying financials so you can focus on what you do best.

faqs.q: What bookkeeping services do you offer?
faqs.a: We provide bookkeeping, clean-ups, catch-ups, monthly reconciliations, and reporting for your peace of mind.
Our team has over 20 years of accounting experience, ensuring reliable and professional bookkeeping services.
We primarily use QuickBooks for our bookkeeping services, which is trusted for its efficiency and reliability in managing financial records.
We have a tax preparation partner for your tax needs.
Our pricing is competitive and varies based on the services you require; contact us for a personalized quote.

facts.heading: The olive branch
facts.text: The olive branch is one of the most universally recognized symbols of peace, which dates back to Ancient Greece. It is associated with tranquility, reconciliation, and harmony worldwide. I chose this as my logo for its symbolism and my love of Greece.
